1115-3755-4770-5301.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Rin and Seri triggers, creating a 1/1 Dog creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Dog token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1400-4619-6495.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1400-4619-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Teysa triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token that is black due to Darkest Hour.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.

851-2557-6763-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Horizon Explorer.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

997-2946-4871-6248.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
997-2946-4871-6248.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Phenomenon Investigators trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

215-1355-4785.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four enchantments.
215-1355-4785.description:
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Sanctum Weaver from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Sanctum Weaver by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1368-1753-4289-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-1753-4289-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

924-4149-4599-4871-5434.easyPrerequisites: Gravespawn Sovereign is untapped or you control another untapped Zombie.
924-4149-4599-4871-5434.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three additional creatures.
924-4149-4599-4871-5434.description:
Activate Phyrexian Ghoul by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phyrexian Ghoul ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat steps 1 through 3 two additional times.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Ghoulcaller Gisa by paying {B}, tapping it and sacrificing Phyrexian Ghoul.
When Phyrexian Ghoul dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Ghoulcaller Gisa ability, creating eight 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Activate Gravespawn Sovereign by tapping five Zombies, returning Phyrexian Ghoul from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Phyrexian Ghoul by sacrificing Ghoulcaller Gisa.
When Ghoulcaller Gisa dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phyrexian Ghoul ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Gravespawn Sovereign by tapping five Zombies, returning Ghoulcaller Gisa from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
924-4149-4599-4871-5434.notes: If Phyrexian Ghoul starts with a power of 4 or greater, you can reduce the number of additional creatures you control. It must get to 8 or higher power before sacrificing it to Gisa.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

3094-4659-5149-5434-7344.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in your graveyard.
3094-4659-5149-5434-7344.description:
Cast Brilliance Unleashed by paying {4}{U}{R}. Choose its second mode, targeting any artifact card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's second ability by paying {1} due to Power Artifact and tapping it, targeting Brilliance Unleashed.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Lithoform Engine, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Lithoform Engine ability, copying Brilliance Unleashed, targeting Lithoform Engine.
Resolve the copy of Brilliance Unleashed, returning Lithoform Engine from your graveyard to the battlefield as a 3/3 Robot artifact creature.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-4885-7605.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4885-7605.description:
Cast Indulge by paying {2}{R}.
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached as an attacker. Indulge triggers, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Citizen token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-4885-7605.notes: Afterwards, you can cast Excess from your graveyard for {1}{R} to create Treasures.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any additional creature without summoning sickness you control

uses.n: Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life

requires.n: Permanent with Landfall Ability: Create Creature Token(s)

1671-1993-3259--85--106.easyPrerequisites: You control eight or fewer lands.
1671-1993-3259--85--106.notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
1671-1993-3259--85--106.description:
Activate Budoka Gardener by tapping it, putting Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield.
Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, triggering itself and the permanent with a landfall ability.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the landfall trigger, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage to an opponent with the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token from step 4, untap all creatures you control, and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

2646-4559-4659-7306.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
2646-4559-4659-7306.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Bloodspore Thrinax.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: is paired with Patron of the Arts

851-1409-1652.description:
Activate Patron of the Arts by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Patron of the Arts enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Patron of the Arts.
Resolve the Patron of the Arts trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4050-6972-7156.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Arcbound Hybrid.
When Arcbound Hybrid dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Hybrid's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Hybrid from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Repeat.

1580-4050-5477.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton, adding {B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a creature token and putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1052-2511-6553.easyPrerequisites: Minion's Return attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
1052-2511-6553.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Minion's Return triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Minion's Return from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

4484-4871-5111-6518.notablePrerequisites: A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
4484-4871-5111-6518.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
When Ebondeath enters, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Ebondeath and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Ebondeath dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.

659-5231-6410.notablePrerequisites: You control a number of Goblins that is equal to or greater than six plus Krenko's commander tax.
659-5231-6410.description:
Activate Krenko by tapping it, creating a number of 1/1 Goblin creature tokens equal to the number of Goblins you control.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Krenko, adding {R}.
Choose to return Krenko to the command zone from your graveyard.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing a Goblin, adding {R}.
Repeat step 4 until you have enough mana to cast Krenko.
Cast Krenko from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{R} plus commander tax.
Repeat.

2136-2645-6252.notablePrerequisites:
Boommobile is a creature.
Orthion does not have summoning sickness.
2136-2645-6252.description:
Activate Orthion's second ability by paying {6}{R}{R}{R} and tapping it, creating five token copies of Boommobile with haste.
When the Boommobile tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, adding {16}{R}{R}{R}{R} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Orthion.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
2136-2645-6252.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may instead target other creature(s) using Orthion's ability, activate a Boommobile's ability to deal infinite damage to any target(s), or activate Staff of Domination's abilities.

2239-2665-4872.notablePrerequisites:
Enough mana available to cast the extra turn spell each turn.
Progenitor Mimic is a copy of Ardent Elementalist.
2239-2665-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating a token copy of Ardent Elementalist.
When the token Ardent Elementalist enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

539-962-3932.notablePrerequisites: Hope Tender and Yurlok of Scorch Thrash do not have summoning sickness.
539-962-3932.description:
Activate Yurlok or Scorch Thrash by paying {1} and tapping it, causing each player to add {B}{R}{G}.
Activate Hope Tender's second ability by paying {1}, tapping and exerting it, untapping it and Yurlok.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Once each player has infinite mana, repeat step 2 until you have an empty mana pool.
Move to the next step or phase, causing each player to lose life equal to the mana they lost.
Each opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

398-5016.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal damage to Spitemare.
398-5016.description:
Cast Angelfire Ignition by paying {1}{R}{W}, giving Spitemare lifelink and indestructible until end of turn.
Deal damage to Spitemare.
Spitemare triggers, dealing 2 damage to itself and causing you to gain two life.
Repeat step 3.
